title: Get InstaHeadshots AI headshots for $60
excerpt: Refresh your résumé, LinkedIn and more.
content_html:
TL;DR: Get the InstaHeadshots Premium Plan for $59.99 (reg. $200) and receive 50 AI-generated headshots, five styles, and 50 edit credits.

Credit: InstaHeadshots

$59.99
$200 Save $140.01

InstaHeadshots can create professional-looking AI headshots in about 15 minutes, without requiring a professional photoshoot. The InstaHeadshots Premium Plan is on sale for $59.99 (reg. $200), and all you need to get started is 10 photos of yourself.

Upload your images, choose from five styles, and let the AI generate a collection of headshots for your LinkedIn profile, résumé, website, or other professional needs.

The Premium Plan includes 50 AI-generated headshots in five different styles, giving you more options than a single studio portrait. Uploading photos from different angles and lighting conditions can help the generator create results tailored to your appearance. The plan also includes 50 edit credits, which you can use to request changes such as a different outfit, background, setting, or hairstyle.

The resulting images are generated in 4K resolution and come with full commercial usage rights, so you can use them for professional profiles, business cards, websites, speaker bios, team pages, and résumés. Your headshots are stored permanently and can be re-downloaded, while your account access isn’t tied to a particular device.

If you’re actively job searching, building a personal brand, or just need updated photos for several professional profiles, having a batch of different looks could save you from booking separate photoshoots. The service is also available to all users, and product improvements are included at no additional cost.

If AI-generated photography fits what you’re looking for, this deal offers a sizable collection of professional headshots. Get the InstaHeadshots Premium Plan for $59.99 (reg. $200) while it’s on sale.
